The whole concept of tying someone’s life and self worth to their adherence to corporate lingo, sentence structure, and personality is by far one of the dumbest things that society and LinkedIn has made so normal.

Everyone has to sound or act the exact same, or else they’re not professional. They’re “dumb”. We laugh at them for not talking in a ChatGPT cadence. If you adhere to everything, “you’re smart.” 

It’s easier for AI and talentless hiring managers to hire you because you sound like the last bot they had. You fit their “mold”. No real vision, no real eye for talent or projection, but you meet all the buzzwords/conformity they’re looking for. 

The Kyrie Irving’s and Alysa Liu’s of the world are called the weird and dumb ones for refusing to conform.
